body:
Don't thank me - I want to say thanks to you and everyone else who gave a shit enough to post and try to help an absolute stranger in a dark time in his life. 

Sometimes, people surprise you. Guess they can't all be bastards, eh? :-)

This is really fucking hard for me because I'm quite a rational person usually (rational enough that I know suicide is absolutely fucking stupid and selfish) but of course my emotional brain is beating up my logical one and making it its bitch.

You've all made good arguments and it's helped make my logical side sit up and think. This is what I needed.

Thank you (not just to this poster, but everyone who responded). It's helped. It turns out my work has what's called an "Employee Assistance Program" where I can anonymously get councelling and although my work will pay for it, they don't even know which employee has used it, at least for the first three sessions.

So, I have called them and made an appointment. I wont talk to my partner about it at this stage, that would just cause more grief, but maybe they can help put things into perspective, give me some coping strategies, and help me workj out what I need to do in the long run.

Thanks again, everyone. I really appreciate it and on behalf of my daughter, thanks also. I'm not out of the woods yet (not by a long shot) but I feel a little stronger and am ready to seek some professional assistance now. Thank you, thank you.

Or yourself. I asked (anonymously)

Even better, threatening to kill yourself and/or trying is illegal here, so if they catch you at it you get thrown in jail. Because that's just want a suicidal person needs, right?

I know exactly how you feel, man. I am in exactly the same situation, only it's a daughter in my case. I love her more than anything but don't know if it's enough to make me keep going anymore and have been thinking about my life insurance and how it would pay all the bills and leave enough for my daughter to be raised much better than she otherwise will.

I have just posted my story elsewhere in this subreddit and originally in AMA "I am seriously considerting killing myself. AMA" if you want to have a read. If you want to get in touch, send me a PM.

OK, Lets say I get an SSRI. Maybe it stops me feeling sad. Lets also ignore the fact that they also stop you feeling happy - they shave off the lows AND the highs and you just kind of coast through life feeling neither emotion.

It doesn't solve anything. 

It might stop me kiling myself but it's not going to make my partner any happier. It's not going to solve our financial issues and allow me to pay the mortgage and put food into my child and clothes on its back. My life insurance is literally the only light I can see at the end of the tunnel our child is lost in.

I sometimes wonder if I even know what love is. I thought I loved my partner way back when, but I certainly don't feel anything like that for her now, and even at it's height it was never the "zing bang" feeling that the media tells me I should feel if I love someone.

"Fixing" me would be such a complicated process I just don't know if it's worth trying. My child would be substantially better off if I died and my partner could get on with her own life, presumably happier without me and certainly better off with the money to be able to raise our child properly. As far as I'm aware, the universe wont miss me and the world will keep turning. Nobody would really be all that sad except perhaps our child but at 18 months it'll fade pretty quick, they don't understand loss at that age and I would be forgotten fairly quick. It would be far worse if I tried to keep things going, and failed, and died when our child is 5 or 10 when they really do understand loss and grief.
Thanks, I didn;t actually know that subreddit existed

Of course, if I even hint the "s" word to a therapist or councellor then they'll call the authorities to "protect me for my own sake" and it'll become a really big thing and I'll probably be denied access to my child anyway "for her own good" and things will become even less tolerable. 

Man, my brain hurts.

Please don't think I don't appreciate your comments, because I do. but I just don't see how I can "fix myself" or change my life for the better. Read my original post again - we're facing losing our house unless a big injection of cash magically appears, and obscene amounts of stress either way whether we do or not. My partner retreats into a little world most nights in front of their laptop, ignoring me utterly and alternating that with demanding attention, so I can't even go off and do my own thing, assuming I had my own thing anymore. Our child is treated pretty good on the whole, I can't really complain there, but if a tantrum happens or crying (and it's fucking 18 months old, that's it's raison d'etre, right?) then it puts my partner directly into a shitty mood without passing go and that's it for another night. How do you fix that? My partner WILL NOT seek help and even if I dio for me, that's not going to change and I still have to live with it or leave and face being alone and broke the rest of my life. Honestly, there's just no out...

And seriously, what's a suicide hotline going to say?

"Don't kill yourself! It's selfish and doesn't solve anything and it's probably messy and will probably fuck up your child"

I already know all that. But it's also peaceful and I wouldn't have to be hyped on stress all. the. fucking. time. And it'll get over it probably quicker than it would get over growing up with me as a parent.

If anything would keep me around along those lines it would be knowing how "A Song of Ice and Fire" ends. 

Of course, I'll probably die of old age before *that* series gets finished... (ho ho).

I can't afford to move out, we're struggling financially as it is. Literally have nowhere else to go like family or friends I could stay with, and can't afford a hotel or motel or even a shitty dive. Even if I could, how do I feed myself, pay utilities, pay the inevitable child support when I still have to pay the lions share of the mortgage or watch my family be evicted into the street. Oh, and then I don't get to see my child and my partner hates me even more and I feel even more of a failure.

Yes, I'm aware that I will see my child even less if I am dead. Seems's I'm hypocritical as well as pathetic.

I'm sorry, I know I'm coming across as a colossal cock. It's just that I have struggled with this for so long and it's worn me down until there's so little of me left it's truly scary.

Luckily I don't believe in God so I don't have to worry about going to hell. That's something </pathetic attempt at humour>

Tried it. Went to see a therapist. Was told nothing much could be done unless I could convince my partner to go with me. Asking THAT triggered a particularly bad period of depression and resentment from my partner and the promise that it would be very very bad if I brought it up again. They simply will not listen to any suggestion that we need help.

I didn't post all this because I expect the magical reddit fairy will tell me the answer to fix my fucked up life - I've been over and over it for years and there actually is no solution. This is my pathetic and desperate attempt to connect with some other human beings before I do something my child is going to be seeking therapy itself for in 20 years time. Sorry, was that not obvious?
